description: Search Hacker News stories and comments (Algolia HN index): by relevance or newest first, with date range, story/comment/Ask HN/Show HN filter, author and minimum points. Returns title, URL, points, comment count, author, time, comment text and HN links. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hn-search
